checks.explanation: The 2024 GOP primary did not narrow to a Trump-vs-Vivek two-way race; Vivek Ramaswamy dropped out before the Iowa caucuses (January 2024) and endorsed Trump, while Nikki Haley remained Trump's main rival for months afterward.

BRICS expanded in 2024 by admitting the UAE, Egypt, Ethiopia, and Iran, not Venezuela, Algeria, or Kazakhstan as predicted, so the specific 90%-of-oil-and-gas claim tied to that lineup didn't materialize as described.
India's real GDP growth has averaged roughly 6.5-8% per year from 2023 through 2026, consistent with the predicted ~7% trajectory.

Olaf Scholz was voted out as German Chancellor in the February 2025 federal election (replaced by Friedrich Merz), confirming half the prediction; Emmanuel Macron's term runs to 2027 and he has not yet faced a vote that could remove him.
